title: Context Package — Pre-digested Knowledge Bundle
description: Structured knowledge bundle that Generator consumes directly without parsing files. Replaces raw file-list approach: instead of 'read patterns/table.md and figure it out', Generator iterates knowledge[].pattern and injects.

confidence.description: Aggregate confidence: min of all knowledge entries + upstream artifacts

knowledge.description: Extracted patterns/conventions that Generator directly applies. Each entry is a pre-digested rule — no file reading needed.

artifacts.description: Upstream Task Artifacts (PLAN/ARCHITECTURE/REVIEW) with relevant sections noted. NOTE: Knowledge Objects (context.json / graph.json / knowledge-index.json) are NOT here — they go through Knowledge Query, not as raw artifacts.

components.description: Existing components that should be reused (not regenerated). From graph.json lookup.

api.description: API modules and functions relevant to this task

rules.description: Mandatory constraints that must be followed

pattern.description: The actual convention/pattern — Generator injects this directly. Example: '<统一表格> + <schema表格> + <schema搜索>'

constraints.description: Hard constraints within this pattern. Example: ['<分页字段> 类型', '<组件库前缀> 命名空间']

anti_pattern.description: What NOT to do. Example: '不要手写 el-table + el-pagination'

sections.description: Which sections are relevant for Generator. Example: ['Goal','Scope','Task Breakdown'] — skip 'Risk Assessment','Dependency Graph'

usage.description: How to use it. Example: 'v-model:visible + #footer 插槽'

import_path.description: Import path. Example: '<业务层别名>/components/common/<统一弹窗>/index.vue'

reuse.description: true = use existing, false = reference pattern only

conventions.description: API conventions to follow. Example: ['export function 风格', 'data.result === "1" 判断成功']

blocking.description: true = Generator must follow or BLOCK. false = recommendation.
